h2_unpositioned_link.effect: An unpositioned consumer (e.g. link_alias_live) reads the document state after normal completion, so a same-file forget after the import revokes the exact link, exactly as tclsh leaves it after `source`. Where the document end is withheld (possible early exit, unretained script, function call, unresolved words), the answer stays conditional.
